title: IdentityAccountDeletionRequestedV1
description: An account deletion was requested, by the person or an admin (`actor`): sessions are revoked and the 7-day grace window starts (DEC-65). It starts the deletion cascade, which purges after `graceEndsAt` unless the request was cancelled (doc 06 §8, doc 11 §13.2, NFR-PRV-040). Producer `identity`; aggregate `user` with the account's `usr_` id; `subjectUserId` is that id. Ids and timestamps only (doc 06 §6). The full event is the envelope (envelope.json) narrowed by this schema; the payload is open content, so consumers ignore properties they do not know (doc 06 §4).

userId.description: The account to delete, a prefixed ULID (`usr_`, shared-kernel `ID_PREFIXES.user`); the API's `UserId`

deletionRequestId.description: The deletion request, a prefixed ULID (`del_`, shared-kernel `ID_PREFIXES.deletionRequest`); the API's `AccountDeletionRequest.id`. A cancel ends this request; a later request gets a new id

requestedAt.description: When the request was accepted; the API's `AccountDeletionRequest.requestedAt`

graceEndsAt.description: End of the grace window; the purge starts after it. The API's `AccountDeletionRequest.graceEndsAt`
